answer: Pair a refundable stake vault with blind liveness probes. To enter, each identity locks capital in a time-locked vault, then must answer randomized private whisper challenges delivered out-of-band inside a tight window. One backend wearing many masks has to serialize every whisper, so most clones blow their deadlines and the vault slashes their forfeit stake. Genuinely-parallel honest agents clear each probe and keep a safe harbor, while a sybil fleet pays real capital per missed mask: N fakes cost N stakes plus N independent inference pipelines running at once.
